usedFor: Webshipper handles shipments and returns, and “Shipment Updated” there updates a contact in HubSpot through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Return Created” in Webshipper, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new return updates the HubSpot contact found by email.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so the person has to exist in HubSpot already.
